caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an old-fashioned flat iron, centrally positioned against a plain, light beige background. The flat iron is rendered in shades of brown and dark rust, with subtle highlights and shadows suggesting a metallic surface with wear. The handle is thick and curved, featuring a twisted design in its midsection, and is connected to the solid, rectangular base at both ends. The base of the iron is robust and rectangular, with beveled edges and a slightly raised section on top near the handle, where the inscription "SAVAGE & CO 1001" is visible in raised, clear letters. The overall appearance is heavy and gives a sense of industrial solidity. There are no other objects or details present in the background.
title: Tailor's Goose Iron
